verdict.rationale: No evidence describes picking a storage region or data residency for Portkey's hosted service, whose API sits at a single global base URL. The only indirect lever is the open-source gateway, which can be run locally with one command, plus routing to privately hosted or on-prem models; this lets a user keep request traffic on their own infrastructure. Missing for 10: explicit region/residency selection for hosted logs and data, documented storage locations (e.g. EU/US), self-hosted or private-cloud deployment of the full platform including logging, and any independent corroboration.
